verdict.rationale: Unit documents creating deposit accounts through its APIs, and it has a strong sandbox that it describes as a full replica of production with identical endpoints, so the flow can be tested end-to-end before launch. The evidence does not show the application/KYC-to-active-account flow being fully programmatic, and it never mentions deposit insurance (the accounts are described only as held in FBO structures). Missing for 10: documented customer application/onboarding-to-active-account API flow, evidence of FDIC/deposit insurance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open a real, insured deposit account through the API — application to active account fully programmatic, with sandbox parity so the flow is tested before launch

citations.quote: Create deposit accounts and wallet accounts held in FBO structures.
Companies can build directly on the Unit Platform using APIs and components
Issue cards, open accounts, move money, extend credit.
Unit's Sandbox environment is a full replica of the production environment — all standard API endpoints work exactly the same way.
